newsitem.title: FRANCE: GAN to publish 96 result Monday evening.
newsitem.headline: GAN to publish 96 result Monday evening.

text.p: French state-controlled insurer Groupe des Assurances Nationales (GAN) will publish its 1996 results on Monday evening, April 28, the company said.
GAN said on February 27 -- the day a 20-billion-franc state rescue plan was announced for the group -- that it was expecting to post a net attributable loss of five billion francs for 1996.
The group holds a news conference on its results on Tuesday morning.

The centre-right government has promised a capital injection of 11 billion francs, of which seven billion is to shore up the accounts of the troubled property arm UIC and 3.9 billion is for the insurance division.

It has committed itself to provide another nine billion to cover expected losses on bad loans to property developers as well as property sales and has vowed to privatise the group by the end of this year. The group is 80-percent state-controlled.
